cover_headline_line3: У двери: +500 ₽ или спать в куртке
cover_headline_medium: Spray-paint graffiti street-art lettering painted directly onto the real painted stairwell wall of a Soviet-style panel-house landing next to an apartment door (two-tone wall: pale top, green-blue bottom), bold black letters with a single red accent on «+500 ₽», slight paint drips, huge and readable at thumbnail size, no tent card, no paper, no Canva pill, no stickers.
